_comment: Public ATS boards to ingest — no API key needed for greenhouse/lever/ashby. greenhouse = board token (boards.greenhouse.io/<token>); lever = company slug (jobs.lever.co/<company>); ashby = org slug (jobs.ashbyhq.com/<org>). The AI/startup companies below are the career-ops-style high-signal list, mapped to each company's actual ATS (verified slugs; unknown/moved ones 404 and are skipped gracefully). wellfound/remotefront are bot-protected and only run via an Apify actor (set APIFY_TOKEN + the actor envs) — they are search queries, not slugs.
